translations.web: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
translations.bsb: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked and brings the wicked to ruin.
translations.kjv: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.
translations.asv: The righteous man considereth the house of the wicked, How the wicked are overthrown to their ruin.
